public_api.name: Store
public_api.purpose: Open isolated cron SQLite state; injected aware datetime clock

public_api.name: Store.create
public_api.signature: create(*, name, prompt, project, scope, at, timezone="Asia/Dhaka", every=None, retries=0, retry_delay=60, delivery_target=None, cron=None, misfire="coalesce", grace_seconds=120)
public_api.purpose: Persist one-shot, elapsed interval or five-field calendar schedule with explicit misfire policy

public_api.name: Store.claim
public_api.purpose: Atomic run claim with schedule advance; returns JSON snapshot

public_api.name: Store.finish
public_api.purpose: Persist terminal result and optional delivery atomically

public_api.name: Store management
public_api.signature: list(); runs(); pause(ident); resume(ident); delete(ident); interrupt(ident)
public_api.purpose: Inspect/manage schedules and manually interrupt stopped executions

public_api.name: Store delivery
public_api.signature: deliveries(); claim_delivery(); finish_delivery(ident, token, *, status, error=None, retry_delay=60); abandon_delivery(ident)
public_api.purpose: Inspect, claim, settle and manually fence abandoned sends

public_api.name: Worker
public_api.signature: Worker(store, executor, deliver=None); tick() -> dict | None
public_api.purpose: Execute one due run; legacy delivery callback receives completed run

public_api.name: DeliveryWorker
public_api.signature: DeliveryWorker(store, send, *, max_attempts=3, retry_delay=60); tick() -> dict | None
public_api.purpose: Drain one pending delivery independently from execution

public_api.name: RetryDelivery
public_api.purpose: Only raise when transport certifies no acceptance; allows safe retry

public_api.name: Store.misfires
public_api.purpose: Read durable skip/coalescing history; count_capped marks lower-bound counts

public_api.name: Store.get
public_api.purpose: Inspect schedule, revision and next_due_local in stored timezone

public_api.name: Store.update
public_api.purpose: Atomic validated edit; reject stale revision and active/retry work; preserve project/scope and historical snapshots

public_api.name: Store.uncertain
public_api.purpose: Record unknown execution, pause future occurrences and queue a durable notification without retry.

public_api.name: UncertainExecution
public_api.purpose: Signal uncertain external execution separately from ordinary opt-in failures.

public_api.name: Supervisor
public_api.signature: Supervisor(manager, *, interval=1, status_interval=5); run(stdout, *, once=False, signals=False) -> int
public_api.purpose: Supervise separate bounded-execution and durable-delivery loops with visible status and graceful stop.

public_api.name: parse_when
public_api.purpose: Pure aware future-time resolution; TimeClarification(ValueError) requests actionable clarification

public_api.name: Destination
public_api.purpose: Immutable adapter-provided destination; target property returns a defensive JSON copy

public_api.name: ScheduleDraft
public_api.signature: ScheduleDraft(name, prompt, at, timezone, recurrence, destination, every=None, cron=None)
public_api.purpose: Immutable pure schedule preview state; adapters own authorization and draft lifecycle

public_api.name: build_draft
public_api.signature: build_draft(*, name, prompt, when, recurrence, destination, now, timezone, parser=parse_when) -> ScheduleDraft
public_api.purpose: Validate first time/repeat and resolve actual calendar first match without writes

public_api.name: preview_draft
public_api.purpose: Present full local datetime/timezone, task, recurrence, destination, execution instructions and safe defaults

public_api.name: commit_draft
public_api.signature: commit_draft(store, draft, *, project, now, confirmed) -> str | None
public_api.purpose: Require explicit True, recheck fixed previewed future instant and persist through existing Store.create

public_api.name: cron.__main__.main
public_api.signature: main(argv=None, *, store_factory=None, stdin=None, stdout=None, stderr=None, clock=None, timezone=None, destinations=()) -> int
public_api.purpose: Inject matching store and authorized destination options for confirmed terminal wizard; preserve advanced CLI

commands: create supports --cron EXPR or --every SECONDS; --misfire coalesce|skip; --grace-seconds N; --timezone IANA; aware --at required
show ID; edit ID --expected-revision N [--prompt TEXT] [--at ISO] [--cron EXPR|--every SECONDS|--once] [other supported create fields except project/scope]
senai cron worker --project PROJECT --telegram-account BOT_ID [--once] [--execution-timeout SECONDS] [--interval SECONDS] [--status-interval SECONDS]
senai cron create: sequential wizard when TTY and matching destination/store hooks are supplied
create --when "tomorrow at 1 am" (advanced flags path); --at ISO remains compatible

executor_contract.interface: executor(run: dict) -> str; send(item: dict) -> None
inputs: run: id, schedule_id, scheduled_at, attempt, JSON snapshot with prompt/project/scope/timezone/delivery_target
send item: stable id, decoded target, completed run, attempt and token; adapter authorizes target at send time
outputs: executor string saved durably, exception triggers opt-in bounded execution retry
send returns after confirmed acceptance; RetryDelivery means definitely not accepted; other exceptions mean unknown

storage.migration_notes: Add nullable schedules.cron, misfire default coalesce, grace_seconds default 120 and misfires table; existing schedules/runs/delivery rows preserved. Migration column checks serialized. No Telegram changes. Add revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1; old records preserved. Due advance, retry claims, pause/resume and edits increment revision. Additive unknown execution status: transaction pauses schedule and optionally queues its notification; existing TEXT status columns require no DDL migration. Protected worker-status.json and worker.lock are account-local. Telegram DB schema remains unchanged. Friendly scheduling UX introduces no schema changes or migrations.

shared_file_changes: Coordinator only: route main CLI to cron.__main__.main; inject authorized execution/session and delivery adapters
Coordinator: supply authorized Destination options and matching account store_factory to cron CLI main; do not default to unsendable local tasks
Integrations: consume parse_when/build_draft/preview_draft/commit_draft for per-user Telegram conversations; enforce duplicate-update suppression, timeout, cancel, authorization and confirmation
Coordinator: pin configured project/timezone/installation/account at startup; friendly helpers never mutate saved defaults

limitations: Calendar: five-field standard syntax only; no macros, seconds/year, special L/W/# or random/hashed fields
DST gaps skipped, repeated wall minutes execute once at earlier fold; no per-job alternative DST policy
Calendar search bounded to eight years and 1500 wall candidates; calendar missed counts above 1000 slots are lower bounds
Compatibility default coalesce allows late one-shots indefinitely; choose skip/grace for time-sensitive reminders
At most 100 due schedules examined per claim; call tick again after a large skipped backlog
Unknown execution/send outcomes require operator review; external effects are not exactly once
Destination JSON is metadata; adapters must enforce current authorization and preserve session policy
Coordinator CLI/chat/execution/delivery integration is wired and offline tested; live channel/model/daemon scheduling checks remain unperformed
Friendly English grammar is deliberately bounded, not arbitrary natural language; yearless dates use current local year only
Wizard refuses if coordinator has not supplied an authorized destination and matching execution/store route; final CLI account selection still needs composition
Draft helper commits are not idempotent themselves; Telegram adapter owns duplicate confirmation suppression and per-user timeout/cancel
Friendly wizard defaults skip after 120 seconds with zero execution retries; custom advanced policies require full flags
Friendly times must be future; legacy advanced --at and raw Store APIs retain past-date compatibility
